اقتطفنا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَطَفْنَا (iqtaṭafnā) /iq.ta.tˤaf.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# اُقْتُطِفْنَا (uqtuṭifnā) /uq.tu.tˤif.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
